programme.title: Puppet Master 3: Toulons Revenge
programme.desc: Gestapo agents face killer dolls when they murder puppeteer Toulon's wife in this prequel to "Puppet Master".

programme.title: Joint Security Area
programme.desc: After a shooting incident at the North-South Korean border DMZ leaves two North Korean soldiers dead, a neutral Swiss and Swedish team investigates what actually happened.

programme.title: Thesis (Tesis)
programme.desc: A Spanish film student (Ana Torrent) finds a videotape showing the torture and murder of a missing coed.

programme.title: The Paper Tigers
programme.desc: Three Kung Fu prodigies have grown into washed-up, middle-aged men. But when their master is murdered, they must juggle their dead-end jobs, dad duties, and old grudges to avenge his death.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: China. Chen Wing Yan, a young police officer, has been sent undercover as a mole in the local mafia. Lau Kin Ming, a young mafia member, infiltrates the police force.

programme.title: Prisoners Of The Ghostland
programme.desc: In the treacherous frontier city of Samurai Town, a notorious criminal must break an evil curse in order to rescue an abducted girl who has mysteriously disappeared.

programme.title: Lars And The Real Girl
programme.desc: Lars is content with his artificial girlfriend; a life-sized doll named Bianca. But when he develops feelings for an attractive co-worker, Lars finds himself lost in a unique love triangle.

programme.title: Under The Silver Lake
programme.desc: Sam, a disenchanted 33-year-old finds a mysterious woman in his apartment's pool. When she vanishes, he embarks on a quest across LA, leading him down a path of mystery.

programme.title: The Stunt Man
programme.desc: A fugitive stumbles onto a movie set just when they need a new stunt man, takes the job as a way to hide out and falls for the leading lady while facing off with his manipulative director.

programme.title: To Catch A Killer: Part 2
programme.desc: Part 2. After achieving two search warrants, Kozenczak finds a large amount of incriminating evidence, and later 29 bodies buried throughout John Gacy's property.

programme.title: Terrifier
programme.desc: On Halloween night, Tara Heyes finds herself as the obsession of a sadistic murderer known as Art the Clown.

programme.title: Terrifier 2
programme.desc: Resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to Miles County to terrorise a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween night.

programme.title: Arctic
programme.desc: Sole-survivor of a plane crash, and stranded deep within the Arctic Circle, Overgard is waiting to be rescued, when a sudden turn of events finds him no longer on his own.

programme.title: The Man Who Killed Don Quixote
programme.desc: Toby, a cynical advertising director, finds himself trapped in the outrageous delusions of an old Spanish shoe-maker who believes himself to be Don Quixote.

programme.title: Dark Diamond
programme.desc: After his father's death, a man vows vengeance against the relatives who abandoned him.

programme.title: Oasis
programme.desc: An irresponsible and childish ex-con befriends a girl with cerebral palsy and develops a progressively stronger bond with her.

programme.title: Abre Los Ojos
programme.desc: A very handsome gentleman finds the love of his life, but suffers an accident and needs to have his face reconstructed through surgery after being severely disfigured.

programme.title: I Saw The Devil
programme.desc: The line between good and evil begins to blur when a special agent goes on the hunt for a serial killer who brutally murdered his pregnant fiancee.

programme.title: Control (2007)
programme.desc: The true story of Joy Division's tragic singer Ian Curtis, a tortured soul struggling to find happiness on the brink of superstardom. His music comes to life in this acclaimed film.

programme.title: The Crying Game
programme.desc: An unconventional and unpredictable story follows members of an armed group, their hostage, and a mysterious relationship that unfolds in unexpected ways, mixing tension, emotion, and surprising twists.

programme.title: Texas Chainsaw Massacre
programme.desc: Teenagers are tortured, chopped up and impaled on meat hooks by a demented backwards family. This grisly 1974 blood-curdler ranks with Psycho and Halloween as a landmark in the horror/slasher genre.

programme.title: Eaten Alive
programme.desc: Psychotic redneck Judd owns a dilapidated hotel in rural Texas, where he murders people and then feeds their remains to his large pet crocodile in the swamp beside his hotel.

programme.title: New Life
programme.desc: A mysterious woman on the run, and the resourceful fixer assigned to bring her in. Their two unique stories inextricably link, as the stakes of the pursuit rise to apocalyptic proportions.

programme.title: Deliver Us
programme.desc: When a nun in a remote convent claims immaculate conception, a team of priests investigate, concerned that the woman will give birth to twin boys: one the Messiah, the other the Anti-Christ.

programme.title: Pusher 1
programme.desc: A failed drug deal leaves small-time criminal Frank owing money to a ruthless Copenhagen drug lord. As pressure mounts, he is pulled deeper into the city's brutal underworld. Mads Mikkelsen stars in Nicolas Winding Refns gritty crime thr...

programme.title: Dobermann
programme.desc: The Dobermann and his gang have been hitting the headlines. Banks, post-offices, bullion vans! The whole works! An anthology of robbery, a compilation of hold-ups!

programme.title: Bangkok Dangerous
programme.desc: Kong, a deaf-mute assassin, lives a life of quiet desperation working for Bangkok mobsters. Despite his disability, Kong's mentor, Jo, trains him to be an unfeeling killing machine.

programme.title: Relaxer
programme.desc: With the impending Y2K apocalypse fast approaching, Abbie is faced with the ultimate challenge - the unbeatable level 256 on Pac-Man - and he can't get off the couch until he conquers it.

programme.title: You Don't Nomi: Verhoeven's Showgirls
programme.desc: Trace Paul Verhoeven's Showgirls (1995) redemptive journey from notorious flop to cult classic, and maybe even masterpiece.

programme.title: Good Boy
programme.desc: Christian, a millionaire heir, meets Sigrid, a young student, on a dating app. They hit it off, but there's only one problem: Christian lives with Frank, a man who dresses up and constantly acts like a dog.

programme.title: The Navigator: A Medieval Odyssey
programme.desc: A young 14th Century boy with acute psychic powers believes that he can rescue his fellow villagers by tunnelling their way through the earth. To their surprise they come out in New Zealand in 1988.

programme.title: Black Death
programme.desc: Set during the time of the first outbreak of bubonic plague in England, a young monk is given the task of learning the truth about reports of people being brought back to life in a small village.

programme.title: Jungle
programme.desc: An enthusiastic young adventurer follows his dreams into the Amazon jungle with two friends and a guide with a mysterious past.

programme.title: Fist of Fury
programme.desc: During the Japanese occupation of Shanghai, the star pupil of a recently-deceased martial arts teacher battles a Japanese dojo which seeks the demise of his master's fighting school.

programme.title: District 13
programme.desc: Captain Damien must team up with Leito, a local insurgent from District 13, to defuse a neutron bomb that has fallen into the hands of a local drug lord, Taha, and rescue Leito's sister Lola.

programme.title: Cypher
programme.desc: A suburban dwelling man looking for some change and excitement becomes a corporate spy, but after meeting a mysterious woman he begins to question everything.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs II
programme.desc: In Hong Kong, Chan Wing Yan goes undercover in the triads as Lau Kin Ming joins the police. Both sides face a common threat from a rival crime boss. (Subtitles)

programme.title: Psycho Goreman
programme.desc: An intergalactic warlord becomes enslaved to a pair of Earth children after they unwittingly resurrect him.

programme.title: Howling IV: The Original Nightmare
programme.desc: A successful author moves to a small town after suffering a mental breakdown and is tormented by demons and werewolves.

programme.title: Howling V: The Rebirth
programme.desc: A bloody werewolf massacre from 1489 returns 500 years later in 1989 at an old castle. Tourists start disappearing and are found in underground passages as a hunt begins to reveal which of them is the werewolf.

programme.title: Howling VI: The Freaks
programme.desc: A villainous carnival owner traps a young werewolf to include in his growing menagerie of inhuman exhibits.

programme.title: Dogma
programme.desc: It's the film that's sparked controversy. Two fallen angels search for a way out of eternal exile in God-forsaken Wisconsin while a group of humans and supernaturals will stop them any way they can.

programme.title: Joint Security Area
programme.desc: After a shooting incident at the North-South Korean border DMZ leaves two North Korean soldiers dead, a neutral Swiss and Swedish team investigates what actually happened.

programme.title: The Endless
programme.desc: Two brothers return to the UFO cult they fled to discover that the group's beliefs may be more sane than they once thought.

programme.title: Only God Forgives
programme.desc: A player in Bangkok's underworld faces the ultimate showdown when his brother is killed and his mother orders him to bring her the murderer's head.

programme.title: Memento
programme.desc: A story told both forwards and backwards in time about an ex- insurance investigator, unable to remember new thoughts, who uses notes and tattoos to hunt for the man he thinks killed his wife.

programme.title: God Is A Bullet
programme.desc: After his ex-wife is murdered and his daughter is kidnapped by a cult, Bob Hightower, infiltrates the group to hunt down their leader with the help of the cult's only female victim escapee.

programme.title: The Raid
programme.desc: A SWAT team is trapped in a tenement run by a ruthless mobster and his army of killers and thugs. Stranded on the sixth floor, they must fight their way through the city's worst to survive.

programme.title: Corrective Measures
programme.desc: When a powerless new inmate arrives at a prison for supervillains, he must choose his friends wisely, or become a pawn in the deadly game between the Warden and the world's greatest criminal mastermind, The Lobe.

programme.title: The Wrestler
programme.desc: A washed-up wrestler is forced to retire after a heart attack. His quest for a normal life is an unrelenting struggle.

programme.title: Sasquatch Sunset
programme.desc: In the misty forests of North America, a family of Sasquatches find themselves on a collision course with the ever-changing world around them.

programme.title: Vivarium
programme.desc: A young couple looking for the perfect home find themselves trapped in a mysterious labyrinth-like neighbourhood of identical houses.

programme.title: Possession
programme.desc: A woman starts exhibiting increasingly disturbing behaviour after asking her husband for a divorce. Suspicions of infidelity soon give way to something much more sinister.

programme.desc: Women's Team Final & Individual Qualification | Subdivision 3 & 4 & Women's Team Medal Ceremony

programme.desc: Zac Stubblety-Cook and Sam Williamson contest the Men's 100m Breaststroke Final

programme.title: Swimming Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games
programme.desc: One of the fan-favourite events closes out Day 2 in the pool at the Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games

programme.title: Planes, Trains And Automobiles
programme.desc: Businessman Neal is dying to get home for Thanksgiving, and loud-mouthed Del, a shower curtain ring salesman, is driving him nuts. Will they reach Chicago without killing each other?

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: A cop known for his unorthodox methods teams up with a talented but unruly police dog to take down a powerful drug dealer who has already tried to kill him.

programme.title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
programme.desc: Ferris Bueller is the most popular student at his school who uses all the tricks in the book to enjoy a day off in Chicago with his best friend Cameron and girlfriend Sloane.

programme.title: The Blues Brothers
programme.desc: The orphanage where Jake and Elwood were raised will be sold unless the tax on the property is paid within days. The brothers decide to raise the money by putting their band back together.

programme.title: Back To The Future
programme.desc: Marty, a typical teen, is accidentally sent back to 1955 in a plutonium-powered time machine. Marty must make sure his teenage parents-to-be meet and fall in love so he can get back to the future.

programme.title: Back To The Future II
